brief:
Gaza's Petroleum Authority announced the arrival of four cooking gas trucks and their distribution to approximately 9,090 beneficiaries based on lists dated November 17, Shehab Wire reported. The authority released details of the distribution mechanism and a verification link for recipients to confirm their eligibility.

The announcement came as Gaza faces severe fuel shortages amid the ongoing conflict. The distribution aimed to provide cooking gas to registered families according to the official beneficiary rosters.
